sections.text:
Removes Awakening standby mode from all enemies.
-Removes debuffs from all enemies [Demerit].
-Removes damage reduction from all enemies.
-Removes damage reflection from all enemies.
-Casts karma on all enemies.
-Ability Power 150. Damages all enemies 3 to 6 times with physical star damage with a success value of 100.
-Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Casts Frenzy on your character for 60 seconds.
-Casts Deconstructive Collapse (nullifies buffs) on the enemy Field for 60 seconds.
Increases stats selected in stat slot 1 by 5000
[Additional Unison Effect] Decreases the stats of all enemies by 40% for 60 seconds.
Increases stats selected in stat slot 2 by 5000
[Additional Unison Effect] Casts Kismet on all allies.
